pages.title: The sun flower
pages.text: Grows in the Beyond Plains in rings around the centre of the biome. Glows like a tiny sun.

pages.title: What it is for
pages.text: It is a flower, so the $(l:plains/polovyk)Polovyk$(/l) calms down for it like any other. But the Poludnytsia is the only one he repays with apples.$(br2)$(#8A6A1A)Do not push your luck:$() each gift is humbler than the last, and after five flowers the Polovyk gives and takes nothing.
